integrity: The primary paper was inspected for its frame formalism, four-dimensional search sizes, open problem, and stated symmetry reduction. The accompanying source file symsearch4.py was inspected for the exact normalization and conjugation/stabilizer logic. The bundled checker independently regenerates all 30 subgroups of S4 and every count used in the claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the normalized symmetry-search slice used by the source's symsearch4.py program. It counts frame assignments and coordinate stabilizers but does not test coarsening closure, tightness, or enclosure conditions, and therefore does not solve the full unnormalized four-dimensional monotile problem.
title: Complete coordinate-symmetry census for the normalized four-dimensional chair search
